purpose: Preassemble the T3 Phase 2 scope/interface/lane/acceptance decision so a clean T2 Foundation PASS can move directly to a short human approval turn without reopening product archaeology.
guardrails: Does not authorize Phase 2 implementation or deployment.
Does not mutate Matrix, AUX, Opal, firmware, hosted controller, or backend.
Foundation T2 and required human approval remain mandatory.

commit: owner Mission Control + authoritative Skins scoring/control
conditional_commit: AUTO Vibe ships only if qualified-source replay confirms stable hysteresis/non-flapping behavior without material runtime regression
proposed_scope_contract.operating_standard: Appliance-like field use: normal round operation requires no Mac/Terminal and minimal troubleshooting.

scoring_control_boundary.ace_state: section aceWinner plus canonical skins ace-pot readback

owner_control_transport.semantic_contract: One desired/confirmed owner-control model independent of transport; mutation responses must resolve to confirmed state or explicit uncertainty.
owner_control_transport.preferred_routing: Local cart-LAN direct control when reachable; authenticated remote relay when off-LAN/remote; fail closed when neither path is available.
owner_control_transport.cache_rule: PWA app shell may cache; command/API/device mutation traffic must never be satisfied from stale cache.
owner_control_transport.implementation_note: The semantic contract can freeze at T3; exact local relay binding remains an implementation task validated against the qualified Foundation.

AudioFeatures.source_direction: Reuse qualified WLED AudioReactive -> Vibe16 -> AudioExpression -> AudioFrame path; no second FFT by default.
AudioFeatures.freeze_boundary: Freeze names/semantics/ownership at T3; numeric formulas, smoothing and thresholds freeze only after qualified-source real-audio replay and runtime-cost acceptance.

presentation_rules: stable glyph geometry during readable hold

HealthState.rule: Health is human-readable status, not a raw debug console.

proposed_lane_plan: Create the T3 phase2_scope_lock receipt after T2 PASS and human approval.
Create one integration branch from the then-current authoritative head.
Integrate PWA reliability first, then apply the isolated six-file scoring diff; run host/package closure before any deployment.
Replay qualified-source real audio through the 13-feature adapter; freeze numeric AudioFeatures/Vibe tuning only after runtime-cost and differentiation acceptance.
Recover/bind the qualified-source WBF/font primitive and integrate the Text/Moment framebuffer compositor; validate runtime/current cost.

Implement the retained brightness-quality fix only with a localized output/perceptual mapping that preserves scene structure and full maximum; apply normal invalidation rules if renderer/runtime assumptions change.
Build one integrated Phase 2 candidate; avoid serial live flashes for lane-local intermediate states.
Run intended-owner iPad/iPhone Home Screen scoring/control smoke, Matrix/AUX coherence checks, Vibe/audio physical acceptance, text readability/aesthetic acceptance, and recovery checks.
Advance to RELEASE_CANDIDATE only after all committed core features and integration smokes pass.

owner_go_no_go: authoritative Skins scoring works end-to-end on intended owner device
owner can reliably control Matrix/AUX/system with confirmed state and no Mac/Terminal during normal round use
pwa: Home Screen launch/relaunch survives lock/wake and temporary network loss without blank screen
app-shell cache never serves stale command/API authority
vibe_audio: five manual Vibes remain materially distinct beyond palette alone
bass/mid/high drive meaningfully different artistic dimensions
real-audio replay and runtime cost fit qualified Foundation budget
text_moments: short text readable at actual cart viewing distance
phrase paging preferred; marquee last resort
brightness: low-night settings preserve materially the same scene structure/pixel participation aside from unavoidable quantization
low-end control is meaningfully more granular

future_human_approval_packet.timing: Only after T2 Foundation is objectively PASS.
future_human_approval_packet.recommendation: Approve the proposed core scope, five manual Vibes, conditional AUTO, owner text/moments, hybrid local-first owner-control semantic contract, deferred expansion scope, and acceptance matrix as written unless new T2 evidence invalidates a premise.
future_human_approval_packet.effect: Human approval plus objective T3 checks permits FOUNDATION_QUALIFIED -> PHASE2_INTEGRATING.
